# `silk/execution`

<!-- Generated by packages/compiler/scripts/generate-documentation.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independently owned, caller-funded lazy computations.

## When to use

Use [`make`](#declaration-73696c6b2f657865637574696f6e3a3a6d616b65) when a lazy Effect must outlive the caller which constructs it and be resumed by a
later owner. Use [`drive`](#declaration-73696c6b2f657865637574696f6e3a3a6472697665) to transfer one affine branch value to exactly one take-once outcome
callback.

## Details

Construction obtains one combined package from the selected [`Allocator`](silk.core.Allocator)
and never starts the Effect. The exact body representation and fixed readiness endpoint remain
compiler-private inside the package. A drive may complete, relinquish a dormant Execution, or
trap before either callback when the handle is in an illegal lifecycle state.

## Gotchas

`Execution` is affine. The readiness callback is fixed at construction and must be detached and
non-parking. `drive` returns unit; continued ownership is delivered only to `onSuspend`.

Import as `Execution` with `import silk.execution`.

Public declarations: 2.

## `make`

```silk
pub effect fn make<A, F, O, R>(body: F, readyState: O, onReady: R) -> Intrinsic.Execution<A> ! OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Allocates one combined package and transfers the lazy body and fixed endpoint into it.

### Details

Allocation refusal produces no Execution and leaves every input under ordinary Effect cleanup.

<a id="declaration-73696c6b2f657865637574696f6e3a3a6472697665"></a>

## `drive`

```silk
pub effect fn drive<A, D, C, S>(execution: Intrinsic.Execution<A>, branchState: D, onComplete: C, onSuspend: S) -> ()
```

Drives one legal activation and transfers `branchState` to exactly one outcome callback.
